scope: Bounded storage smoke test. NOT a 1M/10M-user load test, and not evidence of production capacity.
warning: local-dev is a filesystem test backend, not cloud object storage.
limitations: No million-user or ten-million-user concurrency was simulated.
No network, S3 throttling, lifecycle-policy or multi-region latency was exercised.
No TensorFlow model was loaded because TensorFlow is unavailable.
No real patient/donor data was used.
